note: Every number is produced by the scripts in docs/pitch/anim/layout-lab; see 06-layout.md for definitions. Solve times in e1 are measured with 6 workers running at once (contended): use e5 for time claims.

definitions.overlap: two items of different tiles whose rectangles have a Euclidean clearance < 0 (interiors intersect); items = chip, name label, true-position pin (only for displaced tiles); pin-pin pairs are exempt
definitions.hiddenUnit: a unit on the field that is neither drawn as a tile nor counted inside an aggregate tile
definitions.displacement: distance from a leaf tile centre to the true position of its unit (px, and metres at the latitude of the field)
definitions.aggregateSpread: largest distance from an aggregate tile centre to the true position of one of its members
definitions.churn: tile keys that appear or disappear between consecutive frames while carrying a unit that was on the field in both frames
definitions.pop: a leaf tile whose rendered centre moves by more than 3 px beyond the motion of its true position in one frame
definitions.jerk: |c(f+1) - 2 c(f) + c(f-1)| of the rendered centre, px per frame^2
